title: Gift App Rounds Deck
project: giving my gift to the world (public gift swipe app, Machan's second post on X)
example_data: All app screens are rendered HTML mockups with made-up SAMPLE data (recipient "Robin", .example stores).

pairs.ask: What do we call the rounds?

optionA.label: Round 1, Round 2, Final
optionA.desc: Plain and clear. Everyone knows where they are.
optionA.more: Works in any language and needs no explaining. The last round is just "Final".

optionB.label: First Look, Closer, The One
optionB.desc: Named rounds that tell a little story as you go.
optionB.more: Warmer and more giftable. A tiny subtitle under each name keeps it clear: "20 pairs", "10 pairs", "your pick".

pairs.ask: How do people see how far along they are?

optionA.label: Bar and count
optionA.desc: A thin bar and "7 / 20" for the round. Quiet and exact.
optionA.more: Familiar from the decks. Resets for each round with the round name above it.

optionB.label: Three-part trail
optionB.desc: One trail across all three rounds, filling as you go, with a dot for where you are.
optionB.more: Shows the whole journey at once, so Round 1 feels like a step, not a slog.

optionA.label: A moment with Machan
optionA.desc: A full screen beat: "Round 1 done. Ten left." Machan winks, then Round 2.
optionA.more: Feels like a small celebration and resets attention. About two seconds, tap to skip.

optionB.label: Quick slide in
optionB.desc: Cards just reshuffle in place with a small "Round 2" toast. No stop.
optionB.more: Keeps the flow going for people swiping fast. Easy to miss the round change.

pairs.ask: How does each gift look on the card?

optionA.label: Photo first
optionA.desc: Big photo, price on the photo, name under it. Fast to judge.
optionA.more: Gifts are visual; a big photo lets the gut decide. The why line moves into a fold-down.

optionB.label: Photo, price and a short why
optionB.desc: Smaller photo, the name, the price and one line on why it fits.
optionB.more: Gives a reason to choose, which helps when two gifts look equally nice.

pairs.ask: Show the reason, or fold it away?

optionA.label: Always shown
optionA.desc: One short line under every gift: "Prints the day on the spot".
optionA.more: Every card explains itself. A little more to read per swipe.

optionB.label: "Why this?" fold-down
optionB.desc: Tap to open the reason. Cards stay clean.
optionB.more: Follows the fold-down rule for longer info. Curious people tap, fast swipers do not.

optionA.label: Price tag on the photo
optionA.desc: A small pill on the corner of the photo.
optionA.more: Seen at a glance, keeps the text area free.

optionB.label: Under the name, "in budget"
optionB.desc: Price under the name with a green "in budget" note.
optionB.more: Reassuring when the budget is tight. Takes one more line.

pairs.ask: When someone taps Love on a gift…

optionA.label: Fast pass to the final
optionA.desc: A loved gift skips ahead and is guaranteed a spot in Round 3.
optionA.more: Love becomes powerful and fun. Limit: three loves per hunt, so it stays special.

optionB.label: Extra weight
optionB.desc: Love counts double, but the gift still has to win its pairs.
optionB.more: Keeps the rounds honest. Love nudges, it does not decide.

optionA.label: Both move on
optionA.desc: Both gifts go into the next round. Simple.
optionA.more: No extra work now. Round 2 might get a little bigger.

optionB.label: Quick tie-break later
optionB.desc: Both are kept, then one quick head-to-head at the round end.
optionB.more: Keeps Round 2 at exactly ten pairs. Adds one fast card.

pairs.ask: How do we show what made it through?

optionA.label: Picture grid
optionA.desc: All the kept gifts as a grid of photos, tap to undo.
optionA.more: A satisfying "look what you found" moment. Fast to scan.

optionB.label: List with reasons
optionB.desc: Each kept gift with a short "kept because" line.
optionB.more: Explains the narrowing and helps people trust Round 2. Longer to read; folds to five with "show all".

optionA.label: Swap in a fresh pair
optionA.desc: Machan finds two new gifts on the spot. The round stays full.
optionA.more: Nobody gets stuck with weak options. Shows a small hop while it finds them.

optionB.label: Drop both, move on
optionB.desc: Both gifts are out and the next pair shows. Quick.
optionB.more: Round 1 might end with fewer than ten keepers; Round 2 fills from the best of the rest.
